facts.text: The clone drives Keysight InfiniiVision X-series oscilloscopes of the 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000 and 6000 series
'*IDN?' answers maker, model, serial and firmware, for example 'KEYSIGHT TECHNOLOGIES,MSO9104A,MY12345678,06.30.00609'
The error queue is a FIFO of at most 30 entries and ':SYSTem:ERRor?' returns 'error number,description'
The operation condition register ':OPERegister:CONDition?' has its third bit (value 8) set while the instrument is running
The acquisition type is NORMal, AVERage or HRESolution; AVER<m> also sets the number of averages to <m>
The acquisition type is sent as the first four characters in upper case, so NORMal becomes ':ACQuire:TYPE NORM', AVERage 'AVER' and HRESolution 'HRES'
The number of averages is checked to lie between 2 and 65,536 before ':ACQuire:COUNt' is written
The points mode of the acquisition is one of RAW, MAX and NORMal
NORMal points mode is limited to 62,500 points, whereas RAW gives up to 1e6 points
A num_points value of 0 selects the maximum number of points for the current points mode
The waveform transfer format is BYTE, WORD or ASCii
':RUN' sets the oscilloscope running and ':STOP' stops the acquisition

measures.description: Operation condition register (:OPERegister:CONDition?); bit 3 (value 8) is set while the acquisition is running
